children: In one sign of how quickly tech's fortunes have shifted, an exchange-traded fund tracking an equal-weighted version of the S&P 500 is now outperforming the broad index itself for the year.
Big technology stocks loom large in the S&P 500, since the index is weighted based on market capitalization.
The ETF tracking the equal-weighted version of the S&P 500 is now up around 14.5% for the year, while the S&P 500 is up roughly 9%.
This rotation is on display today, with data centers and AI-related stocks among the market's worst performers.
